steps.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one small homepage link illustration in a matching six-piece hand-drawn set.
Input image 1 shows SIX old thin-line icons stacked vertically: use ONLY the one specified below as the subject/composition reference. Do NOT reproduce the other five icons, the page layout or background. Input image 2 is exclusively the approved brush and drawing-style reference: copy its simple charming hand-doodled language, mildly wobbly rounded felt-tip contours, slightly rough ink edge and softly imperfect shapes. Do not copy its person, frame or cube.
Redraw the requested icon as one cohesive, friendly, minimal indie-game doodle with lively slight asymmetry. A consistent medium-bold rounded stroke, approximately 18px at 1024px canvas, visually match the second reference. Only ONE ink color peacock green #086B68. No shading, hatching, gradients, 3D rendering, colored fills, smooth corporate vector look, fake paper grain, text or watermark. Preserve generous open interiors and use very few inner lines, legible at 54–76px. TRUE transparent RGBA background AND transparent unfilled interior shapes. Square canvas, complete uncropped silhouette centered, about 10% padding, fill about 75–80% of canvas, no shadows or surroundings. Output exactly ONE standalone icon, not a contact sheet.
SUBJECT: Redraw the FIRST icon from image 1: a rounded game controller with two droopy rounded grips, a plus-shaped D-pad on the left, two little circular buttons on the right, a tiny happy curved mouth between them. A short curvy cord grows from its top and ends in one small loop like a sprout. Give the controller a small jaunty tilt, keep the silhouette chubby and welcoming. Only the controller and short cord; no hands or character body.

All blank areas must be truly transparent and clean. Preserve the existing composition, silhouette, happy cat face, line position, peacock green #086B68, rounded hand-wobbled medium-bold brush and all main strokes exactly. Preserve tiny roughness ONLY immediately at the stroke boundary; do not scatter any pigment away from the lines. No other changes or new elements, no background or text. True transparent RGBA output and transparent interiors.
